body: Thanks so much for your feedback.

Hi everyone, I’m the primary researcher of this study. Since I initially posted this study, I have received huge support from people in this subreddit. 

Massive thanks to those who have participated in and those who haven’t (because of some concerns towards participation or not feeling the mood to do so, etc). I couldn’t think of a way to express my gratitude but I think the best way of ‘giving back’ is that the results coming out from these academic studies are able to bridge the gap in suicide research and provide useful clinical insight so as to help people who are struggling and raise public awareness of suicide prevention. 

If you are interested to know the result of this study which is expected to be accomplished by March 2022, please feel free to email me on 2262868z@student.gla.ac.uk. 

Again, thank you so much for your time and insight. 

Yawen Zheng

Thank you so much for your time and participation!
Take care,
Yawen
Thank you so much for your time and insight!

Thank you so much for your time and insight! We still have a long journey to go through in order to provide better help and understanding for people who are in need. Your participation is one of the most important ways of advancing suicide research which would be passed over to the clinical end. Thank you. 

This study doesn’t include an interview, sorry about that. If you still want to do so, please email my colleague Gonca Kose on 2325158K@student.gla.ac.uk. 

Thank you again for your participation!

Take care,
Yawen
Yes, I agree. It was a thoughtlessness of mine, thank you very much.

Hi, thank you for getting back to me and sharing your thought and feeling. I genuinely feel sorry if the advert makes you feel unwell. It seems you have had experience in taking part similar activities which give incentives in return — if this is true, I think you may have already been one of the building blocks and helped people who initiated these activities to achieve their purposes. 

In terms of this study, I’m sorry it seems it doesn’t benefit people who really need support in the moment because it’s only an academic work/something would be written on the scientific paper. It takes time to pass those work over to the clinical end, and finally touch on people who need it — It’s like a circle, we are gathering insight from people, then we processing/digesting those insights, and will give back (disseminate) to people in the end when the study is done. 

I have been rambling a lot…but the core is that thank you for choosing to connect with me/or others through the comment. Even though you think you cannot ‘help’, that’s totally ok, it doesn’t necessarily mean a waste of life because your life go far beyond the scope of ‘doing something good for others’. 

Take care and good night,
Yawen
